decisions.reason: As a non-core accelerator program, it is a low-cost exploratory option, but after a year its learning value may already be largely captured and the firm is likely to reallocate resources unless clear synergies have emerged.

The bio-based CO2-negative bitumen binder sits relatively far from a machinery maker’s core capabilities, so if early market evidence has not been compelling, real-options logic favors abandoning it rather than committing further.

The infectious waste decontamination plant was prominently launched with a concrete partner-backed value proposition and fits industrial equipment capabilities, so the firm would likely keep this option open while demand uncertainty continues to resolve.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is closely aligned with the firm’s machinery business and circular-economy equipment focus, making it a strong option to retain for further market learning rather than exit quickly.
